result.note: Tests the August 2026 export-only inventory framework for foreign-invested e-commerce: its scope, the Exporter-on-Record mechanism and seller safeguards.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, the government operationalised a framework on inventory holding by foreign-invested e-commerce companies in India. Consider the following statements about it:
items: Foreign-invested e-commerce companies may hold inventory in India only if every unit is bound for export.
The framework also relaxes the domestic ban on foreign-owned inventory-led e-commerce.
Exporters-on-Record must pay Indian sellers on a fixed timeline regardless of whether the overseas buyer has paid.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the framework applies to exports alone and the domestic ban on foreign-owned inventory-led e-commerce is unchanged. It follows an earlier amendment to India's FDI policy, with Amazon and Flipkart seen as the main beneficiaries.
questions.source: This follows an earlier amendment to India's foreign direct investment (FDI) policy and applies to exports alone; the domestic ban on foreign-owned inventory-led e-commerce is unchanged.

questions.prompt: Under the e-commerce export inventory framework operationalised in August 2026, which entity buys goods from Indian sellers after an overseas order is confirmed and exports them under its own name?
questions.explain: The registered Exporter-on-Record buys from Indian Sellers-on-Record only after an overseas order is confirmed and exports the goods in its own name. It handles customs paperwork and destination-country compliance, and can also offer testing, certification, packaging, labelling and returns.
questions.source: Companies must route exports through a registered Exporter-on-Record (EOR), which buys from Indian Sellers-on-Record (SORs) only after an overseas order is confirmed, then exports the goods under its own name.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the export-only e-commerce inventory framework operationalised in India in August 2026:
items: Export rebates must be passed through to Indian sellers in proportion to each seller's free-on-board (FOB) value.
Export inventory must be kept in a separate, digitally tracked repository and cannot be diverted into the Indian market.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both safeguards are part of the framework, which also gives sellers visibility into final sale prices, order status and shipment tracking. Returned goods must be re-exported, sent back to the seller or disposed of under the rules, and Exporters-on-Record face annual compliance certification.
questions.source: Export inventory must be kept in a separate, digitally tracked repository and cannot be diverted into the Indian market.
